## v1.12.0 — Image generation and speech synthesis

Presets can now have illustrations drawn and character lines voiced. AP sends every request from the browser and does not depend on SillyTavern / TauriTavern back-end features, except their CORS proxy when one is needed. Both features are off until the preset declares them and the user turns them on in the new **Media** tab.

### For preset authors
- New manifest fields **`image: true`** and **`speech: true`** (feature flags, like `storylines`). Without them AP shows and requests nothing, and all `image.*` / `speech.*` variables stay off.
- **`kind: image`** structure, written after the content: `{ images: [{ prompt, refs?, ratio?, caption? }] }`, at most `count` per turn (default 1). Dialogue style uses one tag block per image with `<prompt>` `<refs>` `<ratio>` `<caption>` children; imperative style uses an array field. `refs` is only asked for while the connection has reference images.
- **`kind: speech`** inline structure: the model wraps spoken lines in `<speech character="Name">…</speech>` (the tag name is the structure's `tag`). Like annotations, the markup is removed from the message, never shows while streaming, follows edits, and `history: N` puts it back into the last N messages. Provider tags inside a line (`<sigh>`, `(laughs)`, `[whispers]`…) are kept for synthesis and hidden from the displayed text.
- Condition variables: `image.on` `image.auto` `image.api` (`openai` / `gemini` / `novelai`) `image.style` (the connection adds its own style prompt) `image.sfw` (NSFW blocking) `image.refs`; `speech.on` `speech.auto` `speech.api` `speech.narrator` `speech.characters`. Media is always off on task turns.
- Macros: `{{ap::image::refs}}` (`- <id>: <description>` per reference image), `{{ap::speech::format}}` (short English notes on the inline tags the current speech API understands, empty when it has none), `{{ap::speech::characters}}` (characters with a bound voice).
- CLI: `ap check` warns about media variables or macros without a declaration, declared features without a structure, `image.api` / `speech.api` values that do not exist, speech tag clashes, and `minAdvancedPreset` below 1.12.0. `ap preview` gets `--image <api>` (with `--image-auto` `--image-style` `--image-sfw` `--image-refs`) and `--speech <api>` (with `--speech-auto` `--speech-narrator` `--speech-characters`), using placeholder macro values.
- User module rule editor: `image.on` / `speech.on` for presets that declare them.
- `window.AdvancedPreset.speech`: read a message's speech lines and listen for changes.

### Image generation
- Connections for **OpenAI** (Image API; reference images through edits), **Gemini** (Interactions API by default, `generateContent` selectable; reference images inline) and **NovelAI** (tag prompts, negative prompt).
- Per connection: style prompt (appended to every request in the form the API expects; the preset only learns that one exists), reference images with descriptions (OpenAI / Gemini), NSFW blocking (on by default for OpenAI and Gemini, off for NovelAI).
- Image cards below the story: all versions of an image, full-size viewer, regenerate, view and edit the prompt, download, clear generating / error states. With *Generate automatically* off the card shows the prompt and a Generate button. Results follow the reply across swipes.
- Images are stored in IndexedDB, never in settings or chats. The Debug tab can delete generated images that no chat uses any more (every chat is scanned first; nothing is deleted if one cannot be read).

### Speech synthesis
- Connections for **Fish Audio** (model ids, or reference audio sent inline), **ElevenLabs** (premade, account and Voice Library voices; Instant Voice Clone), **MiniMax** (system and account voices; Voice Clone from your own recording), **Gemini** (prebuilt voices, Voice Library, voice replication with a consent recording), **OpenAI** (`/v1/audio/speech`) and **DeepSeek**. Streaming endpoints are used wherever the API has one, so playback starts early.
- Voices per connection: a default voice, an optional narrator voice, and character → voice bindings. A voice is a built-in voice, a library search result, an id typed in, or reference audio (with a transcript or consent recording when the API needs one); clones are created on first use. *Listen* plays a sample.
- Speech lines get their own thin underline, separate from annotations (both can mark the same text); click a line to generate or play it. A player above the story plays the whole message in order (narration too when *Voice narration* is on), with generate all, progress and download.
- With *Generate automatically* on, the message's audio is prepared as soon as the reply arrives; otherwise when you play it. Audio is cached per connection, voice and text.

### Network and CORS proxy
- Media tab → **CORS proxy**: *Auto* (default: direct first, through the proxy once the browser blocks an address, for the rest of the session), *Always* or *Off*.
- Proxy: SillyTavern's `/proxy` (needs `enableCorsProxy: true` in `config.yaml`), TauriTavern's proxy (dev builds), or a custom public proxy (`{url}` placeholder, or the target appended). Clear messages when the proxy is off, missing, or cannot carry the request: SillyTavern's proxy only forwards JSON bodies, so uploads for voice cloning need a direct connection, TauriTavern or a custom proxy.
- Every connection has an *Advanced* section: Base URL, extra or overriding request headers, and a JSON body deep-merged into the built-in one (`null` removes a field).

### Fixes
- Without the CSS Custom Highlight API, repainting annotations could skip or misplace highlights, because the text was located before the old highlight wrappers were removed.

### Other
- Docs: a new guide section on image generation and speech synthesis, reference pages for the new fields, variables and macros, a CORS proxy FAQ; bundled Agent Skills updated.
- **Built-in Petals 7.12.0** (illustrations and voice).

The artifact format is unchanged (3).
- AP before 1.12.0 does not know the `image` / `speech` structure kinds. Presets that use them should set `minAdvancedPreset: 1.12.0`; `ap check` warns.
- Building `image` / `speech` declarations and structures needs CLI 1.12.0.
